title: Blind triad
description: Three mutually blind reviewers work in parallel, then an adjudicator compares all three reports and settles every finding.

nodes.brief: You are one of three independent blind reviewers for packet {{packet_id}}. Work only from the packet contents, make no assumptions about what the other reviewers will say, and report findings with severity, evidence locators, and open uncertainties.
